theorem lg_target (G : Type u) [CommGroup G] [Group.FG G] (hG : IsMulTorsion G) : Finite G := by
  have h_free_rank_zero := CommGroup.freeRank_eq_zero.2 ⟨hG, inst⟩
  have h_torsion_eq_top := CommGroup.torsion_eq_top_iff.1 hG
  have h_finite := (CommGroup.torsion_eq_top_iff.2 h_torsion_eq_top).Finite
  exact h_finite
